crossRefs.note: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.
If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”
So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.
I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.
for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.
You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you…
But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

translations.web: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.
translations.bsb: Refute me if you can; prepare your case and confront me.
translations.kjv: If thou canst answer me, set thy words in order before me, stand up.
translations.asv: If thou canst, answer thou me; Set thy words in order before me, stand forth.
